# Pleasant Valley pickup tickets

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_64_nukaknights-post-pleasantvalley-abholscheine.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

These are **bills** that you can get as loot from **burnt people**. You can then find these **under "Miscellaneous" in your Pip-Boy.** The interesting thing is that since Wastelanders you can exchange these pickup tickets for rare outfits, weapons and other things. To do this, go to the Pleasant Valley Resort (next to Top of the World) and go to the basement where the seller bot is upstairs. Behind the laser barrier (access only with Rose main quest) is the laundry where there is a bot. This redeems your notes.

From the video below (redeeming 100 redemption tickets), I have sorted the possible rewards in ascending order of probability (rare first):

1. 
 The Exterminator's **Fancy Single Action Revolver** (1) (Fancy Single Action Revolver)
Can drop with any prefix, including Bloodstained, Double Shot, Anti-Armor, etc.
2. 
 **Nice pump gun** (2)
Fixed legendary perks.
3.
